title: Article 42 — Provision for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief

content.overview: Article 42 directs the State to make provision for securing just and humane conditions of work and for maternity relief.
content.glance: State to secure just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.
content.study:
Article 42 underpins labour welfare and maternity benefit legislation. It is a classic social DPSP used as an interpretative aid in workplace and maternity rights cases.

Examination: two heads — work conditions; maternity relief.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Just and humane conditions of work; maternity relief.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 42 direct?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 42 directs the State to make provision for securing just and humane conditions of work and for maternity relief.
